info.title: Atlantis web UI API
info.description: Read-only JSON API for the data the experimental Atlantis web UI shows. It is part of the web-ui experiment and may change. Requests use the web UI's sign-in: the session cookie when web sign-in is on, the server's basic auth when it is off. Every endpoint needs the view permission, and the per-item permissions match what the web UI shows the same person. Responses are never cached. Data that lives on one replica says so through capabilities.

Forbidden.description: The viewer's role doesn't allow viewing.

NotFound.description: No such pull request, project, or job.

Unavailable.description: Atlantis couldn't read the data, usually because the lock database is unreachable.

message.description: What happened and how to fix it, for people.

run_history.description: Job records and logs survive restarts.

cluster_jobs.description: Jobs from every replica are visible. When false, jobs are those of the replica that answered.

audit_log.description: User actions are stored and can be listed.

shared_plans.description: Plan details are stored centrally. When false, only the replica that ran the plan has them.

shared_policy_output.description: Policy check output is stored centrally. When false, only the replica that ran the check has it.

shared_maintenance.description: Maintenance windows are stored centrally. When false, windows live in memory on the replica that answered.

shared_drift.description: Drift results are stored centrally. When false, results live on the replica that received them.

Capabilities.description: Which data the store can answer across replicas and restarts. Data a flag marks as replica-local may differ between replicas.

vcs_host.description: VCS host, such as github.com. Empty when Atlantis doesn't know it.

full_name.description: Repository full name, such as acme/infra.

known.description: False when the plan output isn't available, for example after a restart.

Changes.description: Resource change counts, as in Terraform's Plan line.

items.description: GitHub team slug in the repository's organization.

current.description: False when the approval was for an earlier failure and no longer counts.

cleared.description: Passed, or has enough current approvals.

configured.description: False when the server-side repo config no longer has the set.

prevent_self_approve.description: The pull request's author may not approve the set.

last_activity_at.description: Newest lock or job time the answering replica knows. RFC 3339 in UTC; null when unknown.

tracked.description: False when Atlantis has no status for the pull request, which usually means it was closed while the lock survived.

stale.description: The pull request is untracked or the lock is older than 7 days.

plans.description: Plans are frozen too, not only applies.

until.description: When the window ends by itself; null when it lasts until someone ends it. RFC 3339 in UTC; null when unknown.

last_activity_at.description: Newest lock or job time the answering replica knows. RFC 3339 in UTC; null when unknown.

started_at.description: When the answering replica started. RFC 3339 in UTC; null when unknown.

provider.description: How the viewer signed in: oidc, github, proxy, basic, or none.

enabled.description: False when the server disables the global apply lock.

last_output_at.description: When the job last wrote output. RFC 3339 in UTC; null when unknown.

unchanged_attributes.description: Attributes that stay the same and aren't listed.

omitted_attributes.description: Changed attributes dropped by the size limits.

generated_at.description: When the plan JSON was written. RFC 3339 in UTC; null when unknown.

total_resources.description: Resource changes in the plan before the size limit.
